title: Normalized scalar unit for fixed cochain models
statement: For a commutative ring sheaf and an endomorphism equal to its identity, fix a derived cochain scalar model. There exists a unique isomorphism from its ordinary extension functor to the identity carrying s tensor x to s times x in every section. Models, site hypotheses and tensor generators are those of [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model] and [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]; independent universes are retained.

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text: Construct normalized scalar packages whose models are exactly the supplied models. Apply the package-level normalized unit comparison and its uniqueness. Transport the result through the model equalities in the generic context. This proves the comparison for the fixed models without unfolding any particular coefficient sequence.

theorem fixedScalarUnitUnique
    {R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} {φ : R ⟶ R} (hφ : φ = 𝟙 R)
    (D : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel φ) :
    ∃! a : D.E ≅ 𝟭 _, ∀ P U (s : R.obj.obj U) (x : P.val.obj U),
      (a.hom.app P).val.app U (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D P U s x) =
        s • x
